newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Mbeki due to meet Gore in Washington.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Mbeki due to meet Gore in Washington.

text.p: South Africa's Thabo Mbeki will meet U.S. Vice President Al Gore next week in Washington where the South African deputy president will attend a business summit on Africa, his office said on Thursday.
Mbeki, widely viewed as President Nelson Mandela's heir- apparent, departs on Saturday for a five-day trip to the United States, his office said.

The statement did not say when the meeting between Gore and Mbeki would be held, but said he was also scheduled to meet U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright and World Bank President James Wolfensohn.
Mbeki would also accept the Good Governance Award from the U.S.- based Corporate Council on Africa on Monday at a ceremony at the "Attracting Capital to Africa" summit in Washington, his office said.
The summit is due to be attended by 150 government ministers and business leaders.
